=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1906-1913 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In PR mode the INFO line ("selected ... for the age-based purge; PR mode keeps them (see WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PURGE_SKIPPED reason=auto_merge_pending)") is printed before the purge-drop (lines 2145-2168) runs. If the drop fails and `report_purge_drop_ok=0` is set at line 2164 (checkout/amend failure, a non-empty `report_purge_left` re-check at 2155-2156, or a refused lease push at 2157), the `reason=auto_merge_pending` line is never printed and the PR still carries the deletions.
  WHY: The same run then contains two statements that contradict each other: "PR mode keeps them" (1910) and the `::warning::` at 2168 saying the PR still deletes the docs. No data is lost, because both merge calls are blocked, so the harm is misleading observability only. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1044 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In the default mode (WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR=true), commit_report always writes a delivery output (line 2232). As a result, report_branch at line 1044 is empty for every downstream job. deep-audit still runs on pr_merged (line 2346) and api-redundancy follows it, but both push steps exit with outcome=skipped reason=no_report_branch (lines 2895-2900, 3513-3518).
  WHY: Every PR-mode run executes two section jobs, one of them a deep-audit job of up to 75 minutes (line 2363), and then discards their output. The LLM spend and job minutes produce no delivered content.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan P1 (docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md, "Report delivery (P1)" lines 155-183) has these parts:
  - `deep-audit` and `api-redundancy` read the report from the run branch (needs.analyze-commit-notify.outputs.report_branch) and push their section commits to that branch.
  - A new `publish-report` job (needs: [analyze-commit-notify, deep-audit, api-redundancy], `if: always() && needs.analyze-commit-notify.outputs.report_branch != ''`) opens the PR and uploads the `workflow-log-analysis-report-final` artifact.
  - Rollback goes through the repo variable `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PUBLISH_MODE` (`pr`/`push`), implemented in scripts/workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.sh and tested by tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.py.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml in four places:
  - a new `publish-report` job;
  - the `analyze-commit-notify` outputs `committed`/`report_branch` (around lines 1038-1044);
  - the deep-audit section push step (2895-2901);
  - the api-redundancy section push step (3513-3519).
  It also requires the new scripts/workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.sh and tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.py.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No `publish-report` job, `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PUBLISH_MODE`, `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PUBLISH` prefix or `workflow-log-analysis-report-final` upload exists outside the plan doc; grep for `publish-report` matches only `deliver-report`. scripts/workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.sh and its test do not exist; only the pre-#9116 scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh exists. `committed`/`report_branch` are gated on `steps.commit_report.outputs.delivery == ''` (line 1044), while commit_report always sets delivery on a committed run (line 2232), so both outputs are blank downstream. Both section jobs therefore take the `outcome=skipped reason=no_report_branch` exit (2895-2900, 3513-3518) and print `::warning::... committed locally but not delivered`, so their sections are computed and discarded on every run. agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md (and changelog.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md) label this "Known gap (deferred)", but the plan does not defer it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:line 1910 (compare purge-drop block at lines 2150-2168) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PR-mode INFO line ("...PR mode keeps them (see WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PURGE_SKIPPED reason=auto_merge_pending).") runs before the purge-drop. If the drop fails (checkout/amend chain breaks, the `report_purge_left` re-check at 2155-2156 still lists a deletion, or the lease push at 2157 is refused), `report_purge_drop_ok=0` is set (2164) and the `auto_merge_pending` line (2162) is never printed. The `::warning::` at 2168 then says the opposite. The same mismatch happens when the rebase removes the deletions on its own: `report_purged_paths` is empty and no `auto_merge_pending` line appears.
  WHY: Nothing is lost, because a failed drop blocks both merge calls. The run log contradicts itself, though. Moving the INFO line after the drop, or wording it from `report_purge_drop_ok`, would fix this.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: Plan P1 (docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md) has three parts:
  - deep-audit/api-redundancy read the report from and push to the run branch (`needs.analyze-commit-notify.outputs.report_branch`);
  - a `publish-report` job opens the PR and uploads `workflow-log-analysis-report-final`;
  - `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PUBLISH_MODE` (`pr`/`push`) is the rollback switch, implemented in scripts/workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.sh and tested by tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_publish_report.py.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml in four places: a new `publish-report` job, the `committed`/`report_branch` outputs (around lines 1043-1044), the deep-audit push (around 2895-2901) and the api-redundancy push (around 3514-3517). Also the new script and test.
  Evidence of absence: Outside the plan doc there is no `publish-report`, `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PUBLISH_MODE` or `workflow-log-analysis-report-final`. The outputs are set only when `delivery == ''`, and commit_report always sets delivery, so both outputs are blank. deep-audit (allowed at line ~2346) and api-redundancy compute sections and then hit `committed locally but not delivered` / `reason=no_report_branch`. The deferral is recorded only in agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md and the editor's notes, not in the plan.
- HARDENING (risk=1): lines 1906-1913 and 2163-2165. Remove the PR-mode INFO line at 1910. After the drop, print the "kept" line only when `report_purge_drop_ok` is 1; otherwise print a plain INFO line saying the PR still deletes N docs (4-6 lines).
- Verified OK, no finding: the `report_purge_left` re-check fails closed; `--no-renames` (2149) is covered by `test_report_pr_purge_drop_restores_a_doc_git_would_pair_as_a_rename`; the INFO `purged`→`selected` change is non-contractual; the PURGE_SKIPPED shapes are additive and registered; the `xargs ... git checkout HEAD~1 --` inputs are safe; `REPORT_FILE` is regex-validated.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
